test_eigen_fixed_matrices: test pybind11 Eigen fixed-size matrix bindings with numpy arrays for row and column major order
test_eigen_dense_matrices: test pybind11 Eigen dynamic-size dense matrix bindings with numpy arrays for row and column major order
test_eigen_partially_fixed: test pybind11 Eigen partially fixed-size matrix bindings that accept numpy arrays with one compile-time dimension
test_eigen_mutator_descriptors: test pybind11 Eigen mutator functions that enforce numpy array shape, contiguity, and writeable flags
test_eigen_cpp_casting: test pybind11 Eigen C++ casting between numpy arrays and Eigen matrix types by copy or reference
